dashboard.title: Ukukhangisa
dashboard.buySponsoredPlacement: Thenga indawo Exhaswe Ngemali yezinhlu zakho ezifanelekile
dashboard.setupNotice: Setha i-akhawunti yakho yokukhangisa ukuze uqale.
dashboard.balanceNotice: Kukhonyiwe kumikhankaso engalethiwe ngokugcwele. Kusetshenziswa kabusha kuphela kokukhangisa kwe-Unity kwesikhathi esizayo — akukwazi ukukhishwa njengemali.
dashboard.fixedPrepaidNotice: Amaphakheji akhokhelwe kusengaphambili anesilinganiso esimile — akukho ukukhokhiswa ngokuchofoza noma ngokubukwa.

create.heading: Umkhankaso omusha
create.description: Khetha iphakheji, khetha ukuthi yiluphi uhlu ozolukhangisa, bese usetha usuku lokuphela. Uzoxhasa umkhankaso esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
create.noAdvertiserNotice: Udinga i-akhawunti yokukhangisa kuqala — buyela emuva bese usetha eyodwa.
create.tierGuaranteeNotice: Amazinga aphakeme athola indawo eyisikhathi esiphambili, ebonakala kakhulu — iphakheji iqinisekisa kuphela isabelo sokubukwa esivunyiwe, akusoze kwaqinisekiswa ukuthengiswa noma inani lokuchofoza.

errors.completeAllFields: Sicela ugcwalise yonke insimu ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
errors.generic: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle — sicela uzame futhi.
